messages:
mia-sales: Quick heads-up — Radiant Health wants a POC. They want to serve a custom medgen-3B variant that their team quantized to 8-bit (custom weights). Can we confirm runtime compatibility, perf, and cost for Dedicated vs Hosted? They also have basic security asks about KMS and data residency.

sam-se: Do we have the model format? (HF `pytorch_state_dict` vs GGUF vs Safetensors) runtime support depends on that.

mia-sales: They uploaded a tar with safetensors + a small conversion script. Said it runs locally with bitsandbytes int8.

lee-ml: OK — quick checklist: architecture (causal transformer) sounds fine. We support safetensors and bnb int8 paths but need to validate kv-cache layout and tokenizer compat. Can you share a 100-token sample input + model files?

mia-sales: Uploaded a sharable link to the bundle in the deal workspace — pinged the customer to confirm sample input. @sam-se can you take the files?

sam-se: grabbing it now. First pass: model loads with our quantized loader but we saw an unsupported op in the traced graph (rotary pos emb variant). I'll run a compatibility shim and try a short generate.

lee-ml: If the rotatory variant differs, we have two options: 1) add a small op fallback in runtime (fast, low-risk) or 2) convert weights to our canonical rotary implementation (longer, cleaner). For a POC I'd do the shim.

tara-prod: From a rollout perspective we can ship as a model variant in the catalog and pin the customer to a dedicated pool. Canary rollouts + automatic fallback to a verified open model (e.g., medgen-3B-base) if the shim fails. Need to record the shim as a custom runtime patch in the model metadata.

sam-se: Did a short perf run on a g4dn-like instance (T4 emulation) vs an A10G. Results (rough):
```
- T4 (single GPU): ~12-15 tokens/s at 512 context, 8-bit
- A10G: ~40-48 tokens/s at 512 context, 8-bit
- Memory: ~6.2GB VRAM (int8) + ~1.1GB KV cache @512
```
If they want sub-200ms first-token on short prompts we'll need A10G or batching + caching.

mia-sales: They asked about Dedicated pricing and a short monthly commit. Any estimates for a small Dedicated pool (2 x A10G) and what throughput we guarantee?

tara-prod: Ballpark: reserved commit for 2x A10G with 99.5% uptime and model pinned = monthly commitment ~ $45k-$60k depending on term and support. We can do a temporary POC price credit for the first month. I'll sync with bizops for exact numbers.

jordan-sec: Security checklist: KMS ok (we support customer-managed KMS via Private for keys). For Hosted we can encrypt at rest with our kms but required enterprise review for key escrow. Data residency: recommend Dedicated in their target region (us-east-2) or Private. Also need to confirm logging retention and whether logs will contain PII — if so we need masking or separate log retention config.

mia-sales: Radiant flagged the usual enterprise questionnaire items — SOC2, HIPAA BAAs, and ability to sign an addendum around model weights handling.

jordan-sec: We have templates for BAA and weight handling addendums. For HIPAA/BAA workloads we require either Dedicated (isolated infra) or Private. I'll prepare the answers and attach the standard language.

sam-se: Back on compatibility — small failure mode: tokenization differences can skew outputs. Please request a reproducible prompt+expected output pair from the customer so we can run local evals and register a baseline.

mia-sales: Asked Radiant for 10 golden prompts + expected outputs and the sample inference trace. They should have it by EOD.

deploy-bot: CI: compatibility-check job queued for sha abc123 — will run the shim + generate smoke tests and post results here.

lee-ml: Next steps from ML side: 1) run the shim on customer's sample, 2) run end-to-end smoke tests incl. tokenization checks, 3) capture latency/throughput matrix across T4/A10G and a4dn if we think it's relevant. I'll deliver a one-page summary.

tara-prod: Ops next steps: prepare catalog entry template (model metadata, shim note, pinned version), draft rollout plan (canary %, fallback), and draft pricing delta for Dedicated POC.

jordan-sec: I'll draft security answers + list of required contracts.

mia-sales: Thanks all — goal is to have a compatibility verdict + perf estimates + initial pricing by Thu EOD so we can present in the Friday exec sync with Radiant. Marking owner: @sam-se for compatibility, @lee-ml for perf matrix, @tara-prod for pricing/rollout, @jordan-sec for security.

sam-se: ACK. Starting compatibility run now, will post logs here. :mag_right:

lee-ml: ACK — will queue perf runs after sam posts the compatibility pass.

tara-prod: ACK — will follow up with bizops for the provisional quote.

jordan-sec: ACK — drafting docs.

mia-sales: Great — I'll update Radiant that we're on it and will share expected timeline. :thumbsup:
